why.seoTitle: Why GlobeGuard? – Diagnostics on the Level of the Manufacturer's Dealer Tool
why.seoDescription: For most supported vehicles, GlobeGuard offers the same range of functions as the manufacturer's original workshop tester: ECU diagnostics, DPF regeneration, AdBlue service, coding, actuator tests and worldwide remote diagnostics.

hero.titleLine1: The functionality of the manufacturer's dealer tool.
hero.subtitle: For most supported vehicles, GlobeGuard offers the same range of functions as the brand workshop's original diagnostic tool – from a vehicle database covering over 85 manufacturers and more than 1'800 models. From fault codes to injector coding.

badges.updates: Software updates included in the 1st year

pillars.title: What sets GlobeGuard apart
pillars.subtitle: All the functions of a professional workshop diagnostic tool – offline directly at the vehicle or online via remote support.

diagnostics.title: Full ECU diagnostics
diagnostics.text: Read and clear faults from all control units installed in the vehicle – with plain-text descriptions matching the original manufacturer texts. Plus EOBD-II diagnostics for all vehicle manufacturers.

items.systems: Engine, transmission, ABS, airbag, climate, multimedia and much more
items.liveData: Live data with recording, panel and chart views
items.identification: ECU identification incl. part number & software version

coding.title: Coding, adaptation & special functions
coding.text: The jobs that otherwise only the manufacturer's tester can handle: special functions and coding just like in the brand workshop.

items.injector: Injector coding, sensor calibration, ECU replacement
items.resets: Service resets, actuator tests, test routines

remote.title: Remote diagnostics – worldwide
remote.text: Via our diagnostic server, we or your partner workshop carry out a complete vehicle diagnosis – no matter where you are. Included in the first year (fair use).

items.setup: Set up in 2 steps via hotspot or Wi-Fi
items.onTheRoad: Works on the road too – all the way to Starlink
items.audience: Ideal for campers, long-distance travel and fleet support

jobs.title: What the dealer tool can do – and GlobeGuard can too
jobs.subtitle: Eight examples from everyday workshop life that you can handle yourself with GlobeGuard. Available functions vary depending on vehicle, model year and control unit.

dpf.title: DPF/GPF regeneration
dpf.text: Regenerate diesel and petrol particulate filters directly at the vehicle – including a display of the soot load level. No trip to the brand workshop required.

adblue.title: AdBlue system maintenance
adblue.text: Bleed, fill, flush and test the AdBlue system, and check all AdBlue parameters and fill levels.

injector.title: Injector coding
injector.text: Code new fuel injectors after replacement or repair – entering the calibration numbers just like on the manufacturer's tester.

epb.title: Electronic parking brake (EPB)
epb.text: Change brake pads on vehicles with an electronic parking brake: open and close the actuator motors precisely, without special tools.

service.title: Reset service & oil intervals
service.text: Reset oil-change and service intervals after maintenance – one of the most-used functions of all.

sensors.title: Calibrate & teach in sensors
sensors.text: Calibrate and teach in the steering angle sensor, ESP acceleration sensors and other sensors after replacement.

actuators.title: Actuator tests
actuators.text: Directly activate the fuel pump, relays, valves, central locking or lighting and test the complete path from the control unit to the component.

ecu.title: ECU replacement & teach-in
ecu.text: Replacement functions for control unit swaps, teach-in of intelligent components and readout of part number and software version.

compare.title: Same diagnostic depth – four lines
compare.subtitle: The diagnostic range of functions is identical across all GlobeGuard devices. The lines differ in the number of brands, model-year coverage and target group.

brands.label: Brand coverage
brands.pro: 1 brand group, expandable to up to 3
brands.elite: 4 to 10 brand groups or entire classes, up to all brand groups

classes.label: Vehicle classes
classes.pro: All classes: cars/vans, motorcycles, trucks/buses/trailers, agricultural, industrial
classes.elite: All classes, as multibrand per class or ELITE Full

steps.title: Ready to go in three steps
steps.subtitle: No workshop training required: plug in, connect, get started.

plugIn.title: Plug in
plugIn.text: Plug the lightweight 58 gram interface into the OBD2 socket – powered with 12 to 24 volts directly from the vehicle.

install.title: Install the app
install.text: Install the diagnostic software for Windows or the free app for iOS and Android – connect via USB, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.

start.title: Start diagnostics
start.text: Select your vehicle and get started – with automatic vehicle selection if desired, and in 8 languages including German, English, French and Italian.

honesty.title: Honest coverage
honesty.text: Which functions are available on your vehicle depends on brand, model, model year and control unit. Vehicles with a Security Gateway (e.g. Stellantis brands from late 2018, Iveco Daily) require an SGW unlock or a bypass cable for full communication – in the shop we automatically show you what your vehicle needs.

finder.seoTitle: Find your device – Which GlobeGuard is right for me?
finder.seoDescription: BASIC for cars/vans and motorcycles, PRO for all vehicle classes and modern classics, ELITE for workshops. Find the right device line in a single step.
finder.heading: Which device is right for me?
finder.subtitle: Three lines, identical diagnostic depth – the difference lies in vehicle classes, number of brands and model-year coverage. Choose your line, and the matching finder will then guide you to vehicle type, brand and model year.

basic.text: For cars & vans or motorcycles – one brand group of your choice, vehicles from approx. model year 2008.

checks.oneBrand: 1 brand group, permanently configured (brand swap for a fee)
checks.classes: Cars/vans & motorcycles only – trucks, buses & trailers start at PRO
checks.womo: Camper? The WoMo set adds Truma diagnostics

basic.guidance: Ideal if you drive one vehicle and want to maintain it yourself.

pro.text: For all vehicle classes: cars/vans, motorcycles, trucks/buses/trailers, agricultural & industrial – vehicles from approx. model year 1991.

checks.expandable: 1 brand group, expandable to up to 3 at any time
checks.youngtimer: Modern classics too: serial diagnostics from approx. 1991
checks.truma: Truma diagnostics as a module option for one brand slot

pro.guidance: Ideal for multiple vehicles, older model years or commercial vehicles.

elite.text: The workshop line: 4 to 10 brand groups of your choice or entire vehicle classes as multibrand – all the way up to ELITE Full with all classes.

checks.mixed: Cars Mixed 4–10 or multibrand per class
checks.depth: Same diagnostic depth as BASIC & PRO – maximum brand coverage

elite.guidance: Ideal for workshops, fleets and dealers.

footer.linkWhy: What all GlobeGuard devices can do

hub.seoDescription: GlobeGuard diagnostic devices in three tiers: BASIC and PRO for private users, ELITE multibrand for workshops. Plus SGW licenses, accessories and software updates.
hub.pageSubtitle: Choose your device tier – or browse accessories, services and software updates.
hub.basicText: 1 brand group, from model year 2008. Cars & vans, motorcycle or WoMo only – commercial vehicles are available from PRO.
hub.womoText: 1 brand group + Truma diagnostics. Cars/vans + Truma equipment – for campers & motorhome travellers.
hub.proText: Up to 3 brand groups, from model year 1991. All vehicle classes incl. truck/bus/trailer, agricultural and industrial.
hub.eliteText: Multibrand devices for professional use: all brand groups of one vehicle class – or, with ELITE Full, all classes combined.
hub.accessoriesText: SGW bypass cables, adapter cables and base cables for your device.
hub.updatesText: Annual updates at a preferential price, reactivation updates and PRO extensions for additional brand groups.
